issues.source_quote: After mentioning the likelihood of this marriage to her Ladyship last night, she
issues.candidate_quote: After I mentioned the likelihood of this marriage to her Ladyship last night, she
issues.explanation: Adding “I” makes the narrator, rather than the woman referred to as “she,” the one who mentioned the marriage to her Ladyship. This changes who performed the action.
